regime.call: Megacap-led risk-on melt-up amid narrowing breadth

risk_appetite.evidence: NDX rose 2.83% to 30,482.35 and SOX rose 4.29% to 12,433.17, while BTC surged 6.43% to $86,358.22.

liquidity.evidence: Liquidity composite scored 2 (easing) as TGA fell $6,307B and bank reserves rose $22,484B, with NFCI at -0.560.

volatility.evidence: VIX sits at 14.87 (+0.41%) and VVIX at 85.77 (-1.84%), but MOVE Index rose 5.8% to 80.64, a divergence between equity and bond vol.

confirms: NDX +2.83% to 30,482.35 and SOX +4.29% to 12,433.17 were driven by AI/chip momentum, with AMD crossing $1 trillion market cap.
WTI fell 8.21% to $92.07 and Brent fell 7.55% to $96.03 on the holding Iran ceasefire, easing an inflation risk premium.
Liquidity composite reads easing (score 2): TGA down $6,307B and bank reserves up $22,484B support risk assets.
contradicts: Breadth narrowed even as the index rallied: RSP/SPY fell 1.35% to 0.2750 and IWM/SPY fell 1.01% to 0.3692, meaning small caps and equal-weight names lagged.
Fear & Greed reads 33 (fear) despite VIX at 14.87 and a 2.83% NDX gain, and MOVE Index rose 5.8% to 80.64, showing bond markets are not sharing the equity market's calm.

falsifiers.meaning: Equity vol repricing higher would undercut the risk-on call.
A further bond-vol spike would signal rate/liquidity stress spilling into equities.
Further breadth narrowing would confirm the rally is unsustainable concentration rather than genuine risk-on.

regime.for_w52_engine: This week's gate is not at risk with NDX and SOX both firmly higher, and VIX at 14.87 keeps volatility exposure near the top of the band, though the rising MOVE Index and narrowing breadth are early signals worth monitoring.
regime.confidence_reason: Confidence is medium because equity price action and liquidity point risk-on while Fear & Greed at 33, elevated SKEW, and a rising MOVE Index show underlying caution that the axes do not fully agree on.
